build_ssd_neck: build an SSDNeck module to generate multi-scale feature maps for object detection
build_ssd_neck_depthwise: build an SSDNeck module with depthwise separable convolutions for efficient feature extraction
run_ssd_neck_forward: run the SSDNeck forward pass on input feature maps to produce multi-scale outputs
build_l2norm_layer: build an L2Norm layer to normalize feature map channels with a learnable scale weight
run_l2norm_forward: run the L2Norm forward pass to normalize input tensor features along the channel dimension
